A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Visual Para-Thinker and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–B. All 17 pages of each version support comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, efficiency measurements, component and path-count ablations, and attention analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and adds GRPO comparison results in Table 1.

M1.justification: Visual partitioning, Pa-Attention, LPRoPE, parallel reasoning and summarization, and vLLM cache reuse are unchanged. Appendix B's algorithm and method explanations also match.

E1.justification: Training sources and task coverage remain unchanged. Evaluation still covers PixMo-Count, CountBench, V*, MMVP, HallusionBench, and RefCOCO/+/g; no new dataset or test scenario appears.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds GRPO at both 3B and 7B to the existing vision-task comparison. Other comparators remain; Sequential is relabeled Sequential(SFT), without evidence that it is a different comparator.

E3.justification: Stated experimental settings remain unchanged. However, Table 1's revised final averages match three-benchmark means including V* for Visual Para-Thinker and GRPO, while retained baselines still use two hallucination benchmarks. The PDFs do not establish whether this reflects an intended aggregation change or reporting errors.

E4.justification: The path-count and component ablations in Tables 3–4, partitioning comparison in Figure 5(b), and appendix attention analyses in Figures 8–9 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: Table 1 adds GRPO results and replaces Visual Para-Thinker's 3B/7B V* scores of 67.9/78.8 with 75.9/82.2. Its final averages change from 62.9/71.2 to 67.2/74.8, with corresponding delta updates. Other existing benchmark scores, Tables 2–5, and plotted results remain unchanged; no explanation establishes the cause of these revisions.

T1.justification: The definitions, theorem statements, equations (1)–(9), and mathematical explanations of path isolation, unbiasedness, and discriminability are unchanged, including Appendix B.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same novelty, parallel visual reasoning, and efficiency claims. The new baseline and revised scores do not alter their stated scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations of attention allocation, partitioning tradeoffs, component effects, and efficiency remain unchanged. Neither the GRPO comparison nor the revised scores receive new explanation or qualification.

D1.justification: The Sequential(SFT) label newly identifies supervised fine-tuning for that baseline. Implementation details, training configuration, data construction, and hardware disclosures otherwise match; no GRPO training recipe is supplied.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to RLVR, parallel generation, and prior parallel-thinking methods remain unchanged. GRPO's added table rows are not accompanied by new citations or positioning discussion.

P1.justification: Wording changes are limited to the Sequential(SFT) labels and updated preprint/version dates. Main prose, section order, and appendix text remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 1 gains two GRPO rows, increasing its height and shifting Table 2 and subsequent text. Conclusion and reference page breaks change, but all figures and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: GRPO broadens the comparison, but v2 introduces inconsistencies in the central results. Table 1's 3B V* score becomes 75.9 while Tables 3–4 and Figure 5(c) retain 67.9. Its revised final averages also mix three-benchmark means with retained baselines' two-benchmark means. These unexplained discrepancies weaken coherence and comparability, outweighing the limited benefit of the added baseline.
